topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Sentences and negations in the Present Perfect
title: Present Perfect: Positive and Negative

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect olumlu ve olumsuz cümleleri karşılaştır:
• Olumlu: have/has + V3 → I have cleaned my room.
• Olumsuz: haven't/hasn't + V3 → I haven't cleaned my room.
• already olumluda (zaten), yet olumsuzda (henüz):
  She has already left. / She hasn't left yet.
• just (az önce) olumlu cümlede: We have just eaten.
• never: olumlu yapı + olumsuz anlam: He has never lied.
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect-iň tassyklaýjy we ýokluk sözlemlerini deňeşdir:
• Tassyklaýjy: have/has + V3 → I have cleaned my room.
• Ýokluk: haven't/hasn't + V3 → I haven't cleaned my room.
• already tassyklaýjyda (eýýäm), yet ýoklukda (entek):
  She has already left. / She hasn't left yet.
• just (ýaňy) tassyklaýjy sözlemde: We have just eaten.
• never: tassyklaýjy gurluş + ýokluk many: He has never lied.
explanation.ru:
Сравни утвердительные и отрицательные предложения в Present Perfect:
• Утверждение: have/has + V3 → I have cleaned my room.
• Отрицание: haven't/hasn't + V3 → I haven't cleaned my room.
• already в утверждении (уже), yet в отрицании (ещё не):
  She has already left. / She hasn't left yet.
• just (только что) в утверждении: We have just eaten.
• never: утвердительная форма + отрицательный смысл: He has never lied.

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect: Sentences and questions in the Present Perfect
title: Present Perfect: Statements and Questions Practice

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect'te cümle ve soru alıştırması.
• Cümle: Özne + have/has + V3: You have travelled a lot.
• Soru: Have/Has + özne + V3?: Have you travelled a lot?
• Wh-soru: Where have you travelled?
• Deneyim sorusu: Have you ever ...? – Yes, I have. I ... (sonra Simple Past ile ayrıntı verilir)
  Have you ever been to Turkey? – Yes, I have. I went there in 2022.
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect-de sözlem we sorag türgenleşigi.
• Sözlem: Eýe + have/has + V3: You have travelled a lot.
• Sorag: Have/Has + eýe + V3?: Have you travelled a lot?
• Wh-sorag: Where have you travelled?
• Tejribe soragy: Have you ever ...? – Yes, I have. I ... (soň Simple Past bilen jikme-jiklik berilýär)
  Have you ever been to Turkey? – Yes, I have. I went there in 2022.
explanation.ru:
Тренировка утверждений и вопросов в Present Perfect.
• Утверждение: подлежащее + have/has + V3: You have travelled a lot.
• Вопрос: Have/Has + подлежащее + V3?: Have you travelled a lot?
• Специальный вопрос: Where have you travelled?
• Вопрос об опыте: Have you ever ...? – Yes, I have. I ... (подробности — в Simple Past)
  Have you ever been to Turkey? – Yes, I have. I went there in 2022.

title: Past Perfect: The Past Before the Past

explanation.tr:
Past Perfect, geçmişteki bir olaydan DAHA ÖNCE olan eylemi anlatır.
• Yapı: had + V3 (tüm öznelerde aynı)
• When I arrived at the station, the train had already left. (Önce tren gitti, sonra ben geldim.)
• Önce olan → Past Perfect, sonra olan → Simple Past.
• Sık kullanılan kelimeler: already, before, after, by the time, never ... before
  By the time we got there, the film had started.
• Kısaltma: I'd, she'd, they'd.
explanation.tk:
Past Perfect geçmişdäki bir wakadan HAS ÖŇ bolan hereketi aňladýar.
• Gurluşy: had + V3 (ähli eýelerde birmeňzeş)
• When I arrived at the station, the train had already left. (Ilki otly gitdi, soň men geldim.)
• Öň bolan → Past Perfect, soň bolan → Simple Past.
• Köp ulanylýan sözler: already, before, after, by the time, never ... before
  By the time we got there, the film had started.
• Gysgaltma: I'd, she'd, they'd.
explanation.ru:
Past Perfect описывает действие, которое произошло РАНЬШЕ другого события в прошлом.
• Схема: had + V3 (одинаково для всех лиц)
• When I arrived at the station, the train had already left. (Сначала ушёл поезд, потом пришёл я.)
• Что было раньше → Past Perfect, что позже → Simple Past.
• Частые слова: already, before, after, by the time, never ... before
  By the time we got there, the film had started.
• Сокращения: I'd, she'd, they'd.

topic: Tenses – Past Perfect: Past Perfect – Negations
title: Past Perfect: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
Past Perfect olumsuz: hadn't (had not) + V3.
• I hadn't seen him before. (Onu daha önce görmemiştim.)
• She hadn't finished when the bell rang.
• Tüm öznelerle aynı: I/he/they hadn't ...
• never ile: had never + V3 → We had never flown before. (never ile hadn't birlikte kullanılmaz)
• Genellikle bir neden açıklar: He failed the test because he hadn't studied.
explanation.tk:
Past Perfect ýokluk: hadn't (had not) + V3.
• I hadn't seen him before. (Men ony öň görmändim.)
• She hadn't finished when the bell rang.
• Ähli eýeler bilen birmeňzeş: I/he/they hadn't ...
• never bilen: had never + V3 → We had never flown before. (never bilen hadn't bile ulanylmaýar)
• Köplenç sebäbi düşündirýär: He failed the test because he hadn't studied.
explanation.ru:
Отрицание в Past Perfect: hadn't (had not) + V3.
• I hadn't seen him before. (Я не видел его раньше.)
• She hadn't finished when the bell rang.
• Одинаково для всех лиц: I/he/they hadn't ...
• С never: had never + V3 → We had never flown before. (never и hadn't вместе не используются)
• Часто объясняет причину: He failed the test because he hadn't studied.

topic: Tenses – Past Perfect: Past Perfect – Sentences
title: Past Perfect: Building Sentences

explanation.tr:
İki geçmiş olayı birleştirerek Past Perfect cümle kur:
• Önce: The rain stopped. Sonra: We went out.
  → We went out after the rain had stopped.
  → When the rain had stopped, we went out.
• Bağlaçlar: when, after, before, because, by the time, as soon as
• before ile: She had cleaned the house before the guests came.
• because ile neden: I was tired because I had worked all day.
Kural: önce olan → had + V3; sonra olan → Simple Past.
explanation.tk:
Iki geçmiş wakany birleşdirip, Past Perfect sözlem düz:
• Ilki: The rain stopped. Soň: We went out.
  → We went out after the rain had stopped.
  → When the rain had stopped, we went out.
• Baglaýjylar: when, after, before, because, by the time, as soon as
• before bilen: She had cleaned the house before the guests came.
• because bilen sebäp: I was tired because I had worked all day.
Düzgün: öň bolan → had + V3; soň bolan → Simple Past.
explanation.ru:
Соедини два события в прошлом в предложение с Past Perfect:
• Сначала: The rain stopped. Потом: We went out.
  → We went out after the rain had stopped.
  → When the rain had stopped, we went out.
• Союзы: when, after, before, because, by the time, as soon as
• С before: She had cleaned the house before the guests came.
• С because — причина: I was tired because I had worked all day.
Правило: что было раньше → had + V3; что позже → Simple Past.

topic: Tenses – Past Perfect: Questions in the Past Perfect
title: Past Perfect: Questions

explanation.tr:
Past Perfect'te soru:
• Had + özne + V3? → Had you seen the film before?
• Wh-soru: Where had she gone? What had they done?
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
• 'ever' ile deneyim: Had you ever been abroad before you moved here?
• How long had ... ile süre: How long had you lived there before you moved?
explanation.tk:
Past Perfect-de sorag:
• Had + eýe + V3? → Had you seen the film before?
• Wh-sorag: Where had she gone? What had they done?
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
• 'ever' bilen tejribe: Had you ever been abroad before you moved here?
• How long had ... bilen dowamlylyk: How long had you lived there before you moved?
explanation.ru:
Вопросы в Past Perfect:
• Had + подлежащее + V3? → Had you seen the film before?
• Специальные: Where had she gone? What had they done?
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
• С 'ever' — опыт: Had you ever been abroad before you moved here?
• How long had ... — длительность: How long had you lived there before you moved?
